facts.fact: CRVS Laws reports, on the account of the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship, that in practice a registrar uses the Integrated National Registration Information System (INRIS) to assign a unique system-generated number at the time of birth registration; the page gives no date, no count of offices and does not say where the registrar sits, so the document's published year is used.

systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
systems.tiers: used by a registrar at birth registration; tiers not stated

systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
systems.tiers: for persons over 16; can be issued without a birth certificate

systems.system: Link from birth registration records to the national registration card number
systems.tiers: National Registration Regulations 2019, regulation 6(2)(a): for a person born in Zambia the card number is obtained from the birth registration records
